title: Global Earthquake & Tsunami Analysis
description: An environmental-data dashboard exploring earthquake and tsunami records by magnitude, depth, year and hemisphere across a 2001–2022 dataset.
question: How do recorded seismic events and tsunami labels vary across depth, magnitude, time and geography?
design: Combined event totals and tsunami share with proportional comparisons and time-series patterns. Filters for magnitude, depth, hemisphere and year make it possible to inspect subsets rather than relying on one summary.
focus: Magnitude and depth comparisons expose differences between groups
Time-series views highlight changes across the recorded period
Hemisphere-based comparisons introduce a geographical perspective
Filters preserve the link between the summary and the underlying subset
reflection: Environmental dashboards should make categories, time frames and the limits of the source dataset clear.
coverAlt: Original Global Earthquake and Tsunami Analysis Dashboard with event and tsunami metrics, year and geographic filters, depth comparisons and time-series patterns
